description: This file is a C source file implementing debugging and logging functions for the FreeType project on Windows. It includes functions for message logging, error handling, and trace level initialization, with conditional compilation based on debug levels.

methods.name: FT_Message
methods.description: Logs a formatted message to the debug output and console.

methods.name: FT_Panic
methods.description: Logs a message and terminates the program on critical error.

methods.name: FT_Throw
methods.description: Handles error codes, currently a stub returning 0.

methods.name: ft_debug_init
methods.description: Initializes trace levels based on environment variable.
